name: ranklist
purpose: An ordered list of ids, for example the results of one search. The learner drags rows to change the order.
keys: ↑/↓ focus a row, ⌥↑/⌥↓ or W/S move it

bind.doc: the state key of a list of ids

items.doc: a name to show for each id

hint.doc: the note under the list while it is live
